Run an adversarial sensitivity and robustness battery on a statistical pipeline

Source: R/audit-sensitivity.R
audit_sensitivity.Rd

Automatically stress-tests a fitted modeling pipeline across four structured perturbation families:

  1. Outlier winsorization of continuous predictors/outcomes at tail quantiles (e.g., 1% and 5%).

  2. Leave-one-cluster-out (LOCO) / leave-one-out (LOO) jackknife influence analysis.

  3. Missingness stress tests (contrasting complete-case analysis against median/mean imputation under observed and injected MCAR missingness).

  4. Nonparametric bootstrap stability (cluster bootstrap when cluster_col is given, otherwise row bootstrap).

Usage

audit_sensitivity(
  data,
  fit_fn,
  extract_fn = NULL,
  cluster_col = NULL,
  numeric_cols = NULL,
  winsor_probs = c(0.01, 0.05),
  leave_one_out = TRUE,
  max_loo_units = 50L,
  missingness_rates = c(0.05, 0.1),
  imputation_methods = c("complete_case", "median"),
  n_boot = 100L,
  seed = 42L,
  max_pct_change_warn = 0.15,
  max_pct_change_fail = 0.35,
  sign_flip_fail = TRUE,
  boot_ci_level = 0.95
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame containing the analysis dataset.

fit_fn

Function function(df) fitting the model on a perturbed data frame and returning a fitted model or numeric/list result.

extract_fn

Optional function function(fit) returning a named numeric vector of target parameter estimates. If NULL, statci automatically extracts non-intercept coefficients from lm, glm, lmerMod, htest, or lists with $estimate.

cluster_col

Optional character scalar naming the clustering column (e.g., "school", "subject_id"). Enables leave-one-cluster-out (LOCO) influence checks and cluster resampling in the bootstrap.

numeric_cols

Optional character vector of numeric columns to winsorize and perturb. Defaults to all non-binary numeric columns excluding cluster_col.

winsor_probs

Numeric vector of tail probabilities for winsorization (default c(0.01, 0.05)). Set to NULL or numeric(0) to skip.

leave_one_out

Logical; run LOO/LOCO influence check? Default TRUE.

max_loo_units

Integer cap on units dropped during LOO/LOCO (default 50L) to keep CI runtimes bounded on large datasets.

missingness_rates

Numeric vector of injected MCAR missingness rates (default c(0.05, 0.10)). Set to NULL or numeric(0) to skip injected missingness.

imputation_methods

Character vector of missing-data handlers to evaluate ("complete_case", "median", "mean").

n_boot

Integer number of nonparametric bootstrap resamples (default 100L). Set to 0L to skip bootstrap.

seed

Integer RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42L).

max_pct_change_warn

Relative change threshold (|delta / baseline|) triggering "warn" (default 0.15, i.e., 15%).

max_pct_change_fail

Relative change threshold triggering "fail" (default 0.35, i.e., 35%).

sign_flip_fail

Logical; if TRUE (default), a sign reversal relative to a non-zero baseline triggers "fail".

boot_ci_level

Confidence level for bootstrap percentile intervals (default 0.95).

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_sensitivity" containing baseline, results (tidy per-scenario tibble), loo_details, bootstrap, parameter_summary, and overall status ("pass", "warn", "fail").

Examples

set.seed(1)
df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(80), y = 2 + 1.5 * rnorm(80))
df$y <- 1 + 1.2 * df$x + rnorm(80, sd = 0.5)
sens <- audit_sensitivity(
  data = df,
  fit_fn = function(d) lm(y ~ x, data = d),
  n_boot = 40L,
  max_loo_units = 20L,
  seed = 42L
)
sens
#> [PASS] statci Adversarial Sensitivity Battery: 1 parameter(s), 8 scenario
#> check(s)
#> [PASS] x: baseline = 1.2963, max % change = 4.3%, sign flip = FALSE, boot sign
#> stability = 100.0%
